summary: Iteration 4 covers 7 bug fixes (BUG1-BUG7) + Payroll module + Access matrix + new owner screens. Backend: 26/26 pytest assertions pass against the public preview URL — profit modal_part/laba snapshot, junk parts rejection & import_trash restore, cancelled payments removed from omzet/dashboard/laba-rugi, laba-rugi/cashflow/settings-finance shapes persist, KREDIT normalizes ISO due_date + pay-debt sets LUNAS + debt-reminders lists due≤3d, SOP master CRUD & finish blocking when SOP incomplete, cancel requires owner_password + non-empty reason, employees CRUD + payroll report bonus math (units*bonus_per_unit), settings/access role matrix owner-only. Frontend: owner login → dashboard shows OMZET HARI INI + 'PIUTANG BELUM LUNAS' card (Laba Bersih Real string present in DOM). Lainnya menu confirms 4 new owner items: Laporan Laba Rugi Harian, Penggajian Karyawan, Sampah Import, Pengaturan Owner. All new screens /laba-rugi, /penggajian, /pengaturan, /sampah-import render with expected labels. Stok screen (owner) shows the Bersihkan Part Sampah sparkles icon top-right. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected in the touched screens.

minor.issue: Vehicle 'year' is a string type (Pydantic v2). Not a bug but worth documenting for API consumers — earlier tests failed until we sent '2022' as string.

action_items: Consider adding testID='login-button' on the MASUK button (currently no data-testid, tests had to click by text/coords).
Optional: expose a visible text label 'Bersihkan Part Sampah' alongside the sparkles icon on Stok screen for discoverability — right now it is icon-only which can be missed by less technical owners.
Optional: harden POST /api/settings/access with role-shape validation (currently accepts any dict).
Optional: pytest class-scoped fixture defined as instance method emits a PytestRemovedIn10 deprecation warning in test_iteration4 (harmless; can be refactored to @classmethod later).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3467 lines — should be split by domain (payroll, sop, trash, finance) into modules for maintainability.
GET /api/dashboard exposes omzet_hari_ini (not 'omzet'); ensure /frontend/(tabs)/index.tsx keys match — otherwise the Laba Bersih Real card would silently show 0.
cancel endpoint hard-codes owner password check via verify_owner_password; document that it accepts owner_password from any authenticated role (correct per requirement but non-obvious).
payroll_report uses month_default() but no explicit date_from/date_to override — acceptable, mirrors laba-rugi.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 4 new screens + Stok sparkles + dashboard card verified via UI)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed customers, vehicles, parts, service transactions, credit transactions, one active TEST_Mek_* employee (cleaned up in fixture teardown), several SOP checklist items (some soft-deleted). Also touched db.settings.finance (saldo_awal_bengkel=111222, owner_draw=500000) and db.settings.access (added kasir/mekanik role entries). Owner may wish to reset finance saldo values via /pengaturan.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_payroll_and_bugs.py (~30s). Login endpoint returns {access_token, token_type, user} (NOT 'token'). Service item 'kind' must be 'jasa' or 'part'. Vehicle 'year' is str. /transactions/{id}/start requires body {mechanic_id, km}. Dashboard exposes omzet_hari_ini/omzet_bulan_ini (not 'omzet'). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Owner login on the mobile web preview: fill inputs then click MASUK (no testID; use coords or text=Masuk). All 4 new /laba-rugi, /penggajian, /pengaturan, /sampah-import routes are reachable directly after login token is stored in AsyncStorage.
rca_of_issue: N/A — every requirement (7 bugs + payroll + access + frontend) verified. Test-script bugs found during iteration were fixed (login response key mismatch, vehicle year type, service kind literal, /start body requirement, dashboard omzet field name).
